title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient presents today for a routine follow-up of chronic kidney disease and hypertension. The patient reports feeling stable overall but notes occasional fatigue. They have been compliant with their prescribed antihypertensive regimen and have been instructed on a renal-friendly diet. No new symptoms of acute distress or significant changes in urinary output were reported since the last visit.

Medication List
Lisinopril, Amlodipine, and a phosphate binder.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable. Blood pressure is well-controlled. Physical examination reveals no significant edema or peripheral pulses are diminished. Skin is intact without new lesions. Lung sounds are clear to auscultation.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 4.
2. Hypertension.

Plan
Continue current medications for hypertension and CKD. The patient will maintain a low-sodium diet. Laboratory work will be ordered to monitor potassium and creatinine levels. Follow-up in three months.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
